subject.title: fix(browser): tab creation steals window focus during agent automation

question: Should the extension relay intentionally interpret fully omitted `Target.createTarget` focus/background parameters as background automation rather than CDP's foreground default?
rationale: The implementation accurately preserves explicit CDP semantics, but only a maintainer can decide whether the relay's documented CDP compatibility permits this intentional default divergence.

options.title: Approve background automation
options.body: Accept the current mapping because OpenClaw-owned and Playwright-created automation tabs should not disturb the shared browser unless focus is explicitly requested.

options.title: Preserve raw CDP default
options.body: Keep omitted relay requests foreground-compatible and inject background intent only through narrower OpenClaw-owned creation paths.

recommendation.title: Approve background automation
recommendation.body: Accept the current mapping because OpenClaw-owned and Playwright-created automation tabs should not disturb the shared browser unless focus is explicitly requested.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work in the same direct-CDP focus boundary makes steipete the strongest available decision owner.
